title: On-Demand Storage Security
content:
KryonOS enforces runtime storage permissions with zero friction:

- Apps do not need pre-declared permissions in app.json.
- Within its own folder, an app can read and write freely without prompts.
- If an app attempts to access external files outside its folder, KryonOS presents an interactive security dialog: [ Allow Once ], [ Always Allow ], or [ Deny ].
